scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,SERVER -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @minicity/web" "npm run dev -w @minicity/server"
scripts.build: npm run check:source-size && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts && npm run build -w @minicity/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:source-size && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @minicity/server
scripts.test: npm run test:domain && playwright test --config apps/web/playwright.config.ts && npm run test:integration -w @minicity/server
